title: Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.19232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. translated_title: 超越对齐：通过监督生成器实现EEG到图像的重建
translated_abstract: 视觉脑解码旨在将神经活动转化为人类可解读的图像。近期的EEG到图像重建方法依赖于将EEG信号与预训练的视觉嵌入进行对齐，以此作为图像生成器的条件输入。然而我们通过实验证明，更强的跨模态对齐并不能带来与之相应的重建质量提升。这表明，仅仅改进输入条件是不够的，生成过程本身也需要显式的监督。尽管表征对齐（REPA）通过利用预训练视觉编码器特征来引导扩散Transformer，提供了一种解决方案，但我们发现EEG条件化的生成器难以遵循这些固定目标。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出了生成衍生监督（GDS）：一个图像条件化的教师模型，将静态的图像编码器特征转化到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间中。我们的EEG条件化学生模型……
tldr: 该论文发现仅靠增强EEG与视觉嵌入的跨模态对齐无法有效提升图像重建质量，因而提出生成衍生监督（GDS）方法——利用图像条件化的教师模型将图像编码器特征映射到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间，为EEG条件化生成器提供显式监督。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that stronger EEG-visual embedding alignment alone does not improve reconstruction quality, and proposes Generation-Derived Supervision (GDS), an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the diffusion transformer's internal representation space to explicitly supervise the EEG-conditioned generator.
